import sys
import io
import pytest
from target import get_write_function, utils


def test_write_to_stderr(monkeypatch):
    captured = io.StringIO()
    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "stderr", captured)

    write = get_write_function(None)
    write("error message\n")

    assert captured.getvalue() == "error message\n"


def test_write_to_path(tmp_path):
    file_path = tmp_path / "out.txt"

    write = get_write_function(str(file_path))
    write("first line\n")
    write("second line")

    assert file_path.read_text() == "first line\nsecond line"


def test_write_to_writable_stream():
    class DummyStream(utils.WritableStream):
        def __init__(self):
            self.contents = ""

        def write(self, s):
            self.contents += s

    stream = DummyStream()
    write = get_write_function(stream)

    write("hello ")
    write("world")

    assert stream.contents == "hello world"
